name: Daedric Titan
location: Dark Anchors, The Valley of Blades

abilities.name: Punch
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Scourge Bolt
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack dealing moderate flame damage.

abilities.name: Fire Blast
abilities.description: The Daedric Titan generates a path of flame directly in front of where it was cast, dealing high flame damage and stunning. This can be interrupted to stagger the Daedric Titan and it will cast "Swallowing Souls" instead. Blocking does not prevent the stun.

abilities.name: Soul Flame
abilities.description: The AoE dealing continuous direct low flame damage left in front of the Titan by Fire Blast if not interrupted.

abilities.name: Swallowing Souls
abilities.description: The Daedric Titan unleashes a violent explosion in a short area around itself, dealing high magic damage.

abilities.name: Wing Gust
abilities.description: The Daedric Titan gets down on the ground and raises its wings, then unleashes a powerful gust, dealing high physical damage and launching you away.

notes: Most generic Daedric Titans were simply named "Titan" before Update 6.
A Shackled Titan can be obtained as a mount.

summary: Daedric Titans, sometimes referred to simply as Titans, are quadrupedal imitations of Dragons created by Molag Bal. Though he created them to serve him, other Daedric Princes came into possession of their own soon after their appearance. The Ash Titans thrive among Mehrunes Dagon's servants. Daedric Titans are often deployed as the higher-echelons of Molag Bal's armies. One titan, Ozzozachar, even carries the title "Son of Molag Bal". Unlike the Dragons whose image they were created in, the titans have four fully-functioning limbs in addition to their wings. However, they cannot use the Thu'um: instead they have a crude imitation consisting solely of a flaming essence-drain spell.
